notes.title: MATM: Rogue Mode release candidate 1 (RC1)
notes.notes:
Hello Uncles. this is an update to the beta!



This is only for the beta



RC (Release candidate) builds are beta builds that are ready for the public, but are not released to add more polish/fixes



There may not be any more major additions, but who knows (I don't)





Anyways



The live uncle cam now is a live uncle cam. 

Added 2 new cosmetics

Added 3 new map chunks

Added Every Item Is modifier

Added Drone Strikes modifier

 Added daily challenges (one for each day of the week)

Added disable starting cutscene setting   

Fixed some issues with save files

Fixed some crashes

Fixed a lot of bugs

Added some QQL (You will notice)
